_comment: Manual fixes for episodes whose description has no usable Google Maps link. Supply either {lat, lng} or a {query} string to geocode. shopName overrides the name parsed from the resolved URL.

1dJAIvCk0MA._note: g.page/tempuramikaku resolves to a place ID with no coordinates. Roppongi, Tokyo. Needs lat/lng filled in by hand.

lRIMBk4ysvQ._note: g.page/gyozatokyo is dead (redirects to a plain Google search). Multiple branches exist, so the filmed one is ambiguous. Needs lat/lng by hand.

gvuEbFM-KxQ._note: Description has no shop map link at all, only the vending-machine promo. Asakusa, Tokyo. Needs lat/lng by hand.

iUJLDOzQV28._note: Share link returns a Japanese address, not coordinates; GSI geocodes it to the exact building. Only the name needs supplying.

V2pARScobU8._note: Share link resolves to bare /maps/search/<lat>,<lng> with no place name, so the name comes from the description. Coordinates resolve fine.
